WITH matched_pairs AS (
  SELECT r.riskandmarginpivot, o.timespan
  FROM riskandmargin r
  INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
),
bucket_counts AS (
  SELECT timespan, COUNT(*) as bucket_count
  FROM matched_pairs
  GROUP BY timespan
),
total_count_val AS (
  SELECT SUM(bucket_count) as total
  FROM bucket_counts
),
bucket_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    bucket_count,
    CAST(bucket_count AS REAL) / (SELECT total FROM total_count_val) as share
  FROM bucket_counts
),
avg_share_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM bucket_shares
),
kept_buckets AS (
  SELECT 
    bucket_count,
    share
  FROM bucket_shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_val)
)
SELECT
  SUM(bucket_count) as total_kept,
  AVG(share) as avg_share_kept,
  AVG(share) - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_val) as avg_excess
FROM kept_buckets;
